entries.definition: Receiving God's testimony as governing truth in a response that submits to it. Bare assent can recognize a fact — demons believe and tremble — but saving belief obeys the word believed, and persistent refusal to obey exposes unbelief.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: personal trust in Christ, not mere assent — the instrument that receives salvation.
entries.citations: (Mark 1:27; John 3:36; 12:42-43; Rom 10:16; Heb 3:18-19; Jas 2:19-22) · see Love, Knowing, Faith & Belief, ch. 6
